moderate myopia of less than -6D in mothers
Children whose mothers had no history of myopia
cohort: 133 Chinese children treated with atropine 0.01% eyedrops nightly for 1 year
finding: Atropine 0.01% was more effective at controlling myopia in children with higher myopia, who were delivered vaginally, and whose mothers had no history of myopia.
mod_finding: Children born by cesarean section had a significantly increased risk of myopia progression compared to those delivered vaginally.
